thread.title: Q3 2019 EPS Estimates for Apple Inc. Cut by Wedbush (AAPL)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Q3 2019 EPS Estimates for Apple Inc. Cut by Wedbush (AAPL)
text: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Equities researchers at Wedbush decreased their Q3 2019 earnings estimates for Apple in a research report issued to clients and investors on Wednesday, January 30th. Wedbush analyst D. Ives now forecasts that the iPhone maker will earn $2.19 per share for the quarter, down from their previous forecast of $2.38. Wedbush currently has a “Outperform” rating and a $200.00 target price on the stock. Wedbush also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2019 earnings at $2.73 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $11.61 EPS, Q1 2020 earnings at $4.49 EPS, Q2 2020 earnings at $2.88 EPS, Q3 2020 earnings at $2.55 EPS and Q4 2020 earnings at $3.16 EPS.
